note.value: Quire signature, consisting of double Syriac numeral with decoration, is marked in the bottom margin of the first page and last of a quire; a second series of quire signatures in Arabic added by a later hand; quires of 10 ff.

The original manuscript was restored so that defective folios (ff. 2–16, 22, 92–103, 144–160) were replaced with new parchment leaves and accurately supplied with corresponding text; during the same restoration the faded sections in the remaining part of the original codex were retraced.
Flyleaves: John Chrysostom, Homilies on First Corinthians (CPG 4428) (f. 1r–v) ; Palimpsested folio with two layers of writing in Syriac. (f. 164)
